summary: The filing is a routine Form 8-K by abrdn Total Dynamic Dividend Fund reporting entry into a distribution agreement with ALPS Distributors, Inc. and a sub-placement agent agreement with UBS Securities LLC for an at-the-market offering of up to $75 million of common shares under its existing shelf registration statement on Form N-2. No premium, price, or special-situation elements exist; it is a standard capital-raising mechanism subject to NAV pricing under the Investment Company Act. The fund is the issuer. No board recommendation or advisors beyond legal counsel were noted. No special-situation angle applies.
